newsitem.title: USA: Donegal Group sets 4-for-3 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Donegal Group sets 4-for-3 stock split.

text.p: Donegal Group Inc said Thursday that it has declared a four-for-three stock split in the form of a 33-1/3 percent stock dividend, payable July 15 to shareholders of record June 25.
Donegal also said that it will raise the quarterly dividend on post-split shares to $0.10, from an adjusted $0.09 a share. The cash dividend is payable August 15, record August 1.
The effect of the stock split will be to increase the number of outstanding shares to 5,990,388, from 4,492,791.
Donegal is a regional property and casualty insurer doing business in Pennsylvania, Virginia, Maryland, Ohio and Delaware.
